The '''Conquest of Manaan''' was a confrontation that took place in [[13,220 BBY]] at the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Waterworld/Legends|oceanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Manaan">{{CSWECite|II|282|Manaan}}</ref> [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. The planet was situated in the [[Exploitation Region|region]] actively controlled by the [[Grand Companies]]—[[Merchant/Legends|trading]] conglomerates based along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as [[the Spin]] and backed by [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]—and lay along [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes controlled by Coruscant.<ref name="EGTW" />

The Conquest of Manaan was a late engagement of the [[Fourth Alsakan Conflict]], a war that had commenced almost [[13,800 BBY|six centuries]] earlier, lasted for another [[13,200 BBY|twenty years]], and was one of a fourteen-[[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series]] of wars over [[Politics/Legends|political]] control of the Republic between Coruscant, the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and their respective allies.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Conquest of Manaan was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
